definitions.explanation: The act of going back to one's home, typically after work or an outing.

examples.japanese: {帰宅|きたく}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time do you get home?

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{帰宅|きたく}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll go home after work is finished.

examples.japanese: {帰宅|きたく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦なりそう→なる：01970_naru⟧です。
examples.english: It looks like I'll be getting home late.

examples.japanese: {帰宅|きたく}⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped by the supermarket on the way home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{帰宅|きたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I was waiting anxiously until my child came home.

notes:
{帰宅|きたく} means returning home. It is commonly used in formal and business contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {帰宅|きたく}する (to return home)
- {帰宅|きたく}{時間|じかん} (time of returning home)
- {帰宅|きたく}{途中|とちゅう} (on the way home)
- {帰宅|きたく}が{遅|おそ}い (getting home late)

RELATED WORDS:
- {帰|かえ}る: more casual 'to go home'
- {帰宅|きたく}する: more formal/written

OPPOSITE CONCEPTS:
- {出勤|しゅっきん} (going to work)
- {外出|がいしゅつ} (going out)
